notes: §1985:XI.4.4.4 GR10 defines the output procedure's range dynamically (statements reached by CALL, EXIT, GO TO, PERFORM, and declaratives executed from it) and says "The range of the output procedure must not cause the execution of any MERGE", RELEASE or SORT, stating no result, while §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR1 lets a SORT be written anywhere outside the declaratives. SortEmitter.EmitSort enters the output phase (CobolSort.EnterProcedure) around the procedure so CobolSort.ReturnStatement serves any RETURN executed in the range wherever written; since kb/Work PB5274 VersionConformancePass.GateSortMergeProcedures asks the lexical SORT/MERGE ban only from 2023, and the 85-only GateReleaseReturnRange (ProcedureReach.Closure, GO TO and ALTER followed) places RETURN by range. Probes at --std 85 (work-rs-02/c5): RETURN in a paragraph PERFORMed from outside the section ('R AAA', 'R MMM', 'R ZZZ', 'AE'); a USE procedure fired by a failed OPEN in the range RETURNs ('USE R CCC', then 'R BBB', 'R AAA', 'AE'); (b) unexecuted SORT and MERGE in the output procedure compile and run ('R BBB DONE'; refused COBOL2700/COBOL1572 at --std 2023); an executed SORT in the range ('R AAA', 'AFTER-SORT', 'R BBB') and an executed RELEASE through a shared paragraph ('AFTER-REL', 'R BBB', 'AE') run on, a result the rule leaves undefined; (a) SD RECORD 3 TO 7 with an ODO record RETURNed INTO W ('R B5 B5VWXYZ|', 'R A1 A1X    |'); (f) RETURN INTO TE(K) with NOT AT END ADD 1 TO K ('AAABBBCCC K=4'); (c) a table SORT is COBOL0870. Class d does not reach a range rule. Witness: a RETURN reached by PERFORM outside the section (AAA BBB CCC DONE). History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB5274 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5274 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-02.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-02-refute.json).

next.reason: The range definition and ban are kept. 1985 'must not' states no result; 2023: 'If the range of the output procedure causes the execution of any MERGE, RELEASE, or format 1 SORT statement, the EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist' and the SORT results are undefined (§2023:14.9.40.4 GR13); a RELEASE there also sets EC-FLOW-RELEASE (§2023:14.9.32.4 GR1). 2023 also refuses at compile time a SORT written 'in an input or output procedure' (§2023:14.9.40.3 SR3) and a MERGE written in 'an input or output procedure of a file format SORT statement' (§2023:14.9.24.3 SR1); 1985 SR1 allowed both outside declaratives. The format 1 limit only exempts the new table SORT.
